scenarios.title: List all books
scenarios.given: Book with id=1 exists from previous create; PORT=8000
scenarios.then: 200 OK with a JSON list containing the book(s)

scenarios.title: Unknown query parameter in GET /books
scenarios.given: Book with id=1 exists from previous create; PORT=8000
scenarios.then: 400 Bad Request with error about unknown query parameter

logic: Use a dictionary `books` mapping integer id to book dict (id, title, author, isbn, synopsis).
For GET /books: parse query parameters; reject any param not in {id, title, author, isbn, synopsis, q} with 400.
If 'id' is present, filter by exact id match.
Otherwise, apply all-or-nothing filtering: book must have non-empty value for each provided field (title, author, isbn, synopsis) that contains the query param value (case-insensitive).
Return list of matching books sorted by id.
